method.order: ABBA twice per experiment; paired prompts, sequential clients, no simultaneous measured engines
method.percentiles: median and nearest-rank p95; request-level timing excludes engine start except in startToAnswer
method.memory: Sum of Darwin physical footprints for a sampled stable gateway/descendant process tree at 25 ms intervals
method.writes: Committed prefix payload and staged serialization bytes; changed store file sizes include headers. SSD wear and system-wide writes were not instrumented. Cancelled generation writes are reported separately.
method.limitations: Product launchers differ in LRU entry count, prefill policy and gateway/tokenizer processes despite identical weights, Python runtime and memory budgets. One off follow-up exceeded 50% background CPU. End-to-end start probes check pre-start CPU only.

requests.scope: Two managed execution paths, same weights and MLX installation. Cold means no matching application prefix; OS page cache retained. Memory is sampled process-tree physical footprint. Writes are logical cache payload and changed file lengths, not device I/O.

startToAnswer.scope: From the Start command to the replayed answer through the authenticated gateway. Prior seed and stop excluded. OS file caches retained.

decision: Retain the dedicated opt-in 512-token MLX SSD profile. Defer integration into the 4096-token MLX text settings.
